text:
The plate looks like a square dinner plate about 22–26 cm across. It holds 7 small dark items that resemble dates or olives, each about 2.5–3 cm long. They look like dark dried fruit, possibly dates or prunes with pits. At roughly 4–5 g each, that comes to about 30 g.

Dates are about 280 kcal per 100 g. If these are olives instead, they would be about 115 kcal per 100 g. Their reddish-brown color and wrinkled look point to dates or jujubes, so I used dates.
